summary: John's great-granduncle; named for his maternal grandfather Leopoldo Ferlaino.
bio: Tree shows 'Levyso 1930-Living' - a misreading of Leo S. (and he died in 2019). FS tree has a duplicate 'Leupo' (1930). Born 19 May 1929; 'Leopoldo' in the 1930 census; WWII draft card Q2Q2-N2SB; 1950 machine operator for the State Highway Department. Aged 87 in Nov 2016. Died 1 Jul 2019 in Exton, PA; obituary names sister 'Mary Petriello (John)'. FS attaches him to a sourceless second wife 'Philomena' of Frank Cognetti - probably an error.
occupation: Machine operator, PA State Highway Department (1950)
